items.title: Relational Fundamentals
items.description: Core concepts of relational databases — tables, keys, joins, SQL basics, and the relational model.

items.title: Vector Databases: Architecture, ANN Math & Comparative Deep Dive
items.description: A Senior Principal Engineer's comprehensive architectural guide to Vector Databases (HNSW, IVF-PQ, SCaNN), high-dimensional geometry, memory layout, and full-spectrum comparison with Relational (PostgreSQL/MySQL), Document (MongoDB), Key-Value (Redis), and Graph (Neo4j) engines.
